title: A technician on a custom role made from Office User is offered
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role made for this test from the Office User template, role A, so staff member A is on a role copied from Office User.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on role A, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by nobody (no lead).
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Reload the Board View page.
  2. Open work order 1.
  3. Open the Lead Technician dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A has a column.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 3:

  • The dropdown offers staff member A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-R1: “A person is offered on a technician list at a location when all of these hold: their Technician toggle is on, their Time Clock is on, their user is active, they are enrolled at that location, and their role is not the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role.”
  • S1-N1: “When the role picked in the window is the built-in Office User or Time Clock User role, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "This role can't be a technician." Picking one of those roles turns Technician off. In Edit Staff Member, saving a staff member who was saved with Technician on and now has one of those roles shows the Turn Off Technician warning first (Story 2). Any other role, including a custom role made from either built-in role, never grays it out.”
  • Terminology: “Technician → in this PRD, a staff member whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on. It is not the role named "Technician": a person on any role except the built-in Office User and Time Clock User roles can be one.”
